title: What Mycelium Structure Panels 2.0 Is
definition: Mycelium Structure Panels 2.0: next-gen grown mycelium building panels.
description:
Mycelium Structure Panels 2.0 is next-gen grown mycelium building panels. It sits squarely in Future Materials, the frontier where mycelium mats science becomes panel logistics infrastructure.

title: Mycelium Structure Panels 2.0 Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Mycelium Structure Panels 2.0: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Mycelium Structure Panels 2.0 — next-gen grown mycelium building panels.

Phase 1 — Prove (mycelium mats): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (panel logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (mold growth): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (fire treatment): panel hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and architecture-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
